description: Reference transcriptions of the 84 FLEURS read-speech clips behind Focal's speech-quality figures: six per language and split for English, Russian, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese. The dev clips are the DEV set and the test clips the held-out set of docs/speech-quality.md. Audio is not included; each id names the clip's WAV in the dataset's per-language audio archive.
provenance: fleurs-corpus.json (selection rule and the SHA-256 of every source WAV, PCM and reference)
